hypothesis: M206 and M208 both improve fixed M193 objective and preserve broad behavior/replay gates, but both fail the protected key by moving its normal margin above the pre-registered near-boundary max_normal_margin window. Further same-recipe PPO is therefore likely to keep improving broad loss while washing out protected-key boundary evidence. The next step is to design a protected-key-aware objective or config before any PPO.
success_criteria: do not run PPO or actor updates in this milestone
identify the exact protected-key failure mechanism using M206 and M208 artifacts
define at least one protected-key-aware training objective or config change that can retain near-boundary acceptance without loosening the guard after seeing results
define how the proposed objective/config will be validated before promotion
keep M204 as the current best retained checkpoint unless a future candidate passes all gates
preserve the existing actor observation contract
pre-register the next runnable experiment after design
failure_criteria: run another same-recipe stage6 retry from M204
loosen max_normal_margin or any protected-key threshold post hoc to accept M206 or M208
promote based on fixed objective improvement alone
change actor observation inputs to solve the protected-key failure
skip old M183 replay, refreshed M193 replay, behavior seeds 9505/9506, or protected-key validation in the next runnable milestone

candidate_directions.name: protected_boundary_anchor
candidate_directions.description: Add a small protected-key retention anchor or auxiliary loss that penalizes movement of the selected key outside the near-boundary acceptance window while preserving wrong-history margin gap.

candidate_directions.name: lower_update_magnitude
candidate_directions.description: Reduce PPO update magnitude or number of minibatch passes for the stage6 continuation and require the protected key to pass before any repeat.

candidate_directions.name: boundary_window_refresh
candidate_directions.description: Only if pre-registered, mine a fresh protected-key set with multiple near-boundary keys so the guard is not dependent on one row; do not loosen the existing key retroactively.

commands.name: m209_failure_review
commands.command: Inspect M206 and M208 protected-key artifacts and summarize why fixed-objective improvement moves the protected key outside the near-boundary acceptance window.

commands.name: m209_design_note
commands.command: Write docs/m209-protected-key-aware-stage6-design.md with the selected protected-key-aware objective/config plan and next runnable milestone.

commands.name: m209_next_manifest
commands.command: Pre-register the next runnable protected-key-aware experiment manifest before any PPO resumes.

decision_rule: M209 should produce a pre-registered protected-key-aware stage6 plan. PPO may resume only after that design is documented and added to the research queue.
